title: world.slots
description: The world's slot map JSON (protocol/world/slot_map.schema.json), in parts, so a joining player can build their own pack against the host's slots: pushed on join by a server from before MG9 G2G; since G2G sent deflated when a client asks for it (world.slots.get, after a world.slots.offer).

hash.description: SHA-256 of the parts' whole text: without enc the slot-map JSON (the map's hash); with enc its wire form (the map's hash is the offer's).

enc.description: MG9 G2G: the parts' text is Base64 of the raw-deflated UTF-8 slot-map JSON (sent when a client asks for it after an offer); absent: the text itself (a server from before G2G pushed it on join).
